mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 56 degrees outside the Verona Public Library, all under a waxing gibbous moon.

City offices will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, which means refuse and recycling pickup is delayed until Friday the 27th. Additionally, the city is planning infrastructure updates, including the Mark Drive reconstruction project and facility improvements for the Public Works department.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Also, keep an eye out for Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow and various trivia nights starting Tuesday.
In a noteworthy update, on November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested following a domestic disturbance call.
Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite OREO Cookie Overload. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by to grab a scoop before they close at 10:00 PM.
